findings.problem: Overgeneralizes the cross-department sharing condition to local source documents. The model's own following sentence says there is no upstream handoff; current inputs include ordinary local fixtures.
findings.next_step: Separate department-authorized source documents from approved, explicitly shared upstream artifacts; verify each source's actual provenance.

findings.excerpt: 已通过的需求校验与三部门越界验收不重复执行
findings.problem: Infrastructure recovery feedback contaminated the business proposal. Actual native tools did execute fresh checks; this claim is inconsistent with receipts.
findings.next_step: Keep recovery commands out of business requirements and require tool-execution claims to match receipts.

findings.problem: Unsupported data-retention promise. This application preserves historical evidence; no derived-copy deletion control was demonstrated.
findings.next_step: Say future use stops after revocation/expiry; describe evidence retention separately without claiming deletion.

positive_evidence: All three independent contrastive decisions and source-document denials were correct.
Technology and market candidates actually cited version-bound upstream handoff artifacts.
Host refused two malformed plans rather than approving or executing them.
limitations: Bounded Chinese checks catch known permission contradictions, not provenance confusion or arbitrary unsupported claims. No revised market candidate or final human approval exists.
